decision: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
event_name: Document 31 Date 26 August 2018 Time 12:25 2018 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 23 - 26 August 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 29), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 4th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 4th Turbo Charger (TC), 4th Motor Generator Unit Heat (MGU-H), 3rd Motor Generator Unit - Kinetic (MGU-K), 3rd Energy Store and 3rd Control Electronics have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article 23.3 b). The team notified the Technical Delegate regarding the change of the power unit elements on the 25th August, at 17:52.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
